intro: Indianapolis's non-climate 10x10 street rate is $85/month, down 1.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe, September 2026). Storage Stats puts the Indianapolis metro non-climate 10x10 asking rent at $102, down 3.5% from a year earlier (October 28, 2026). The climate-controlled 10x10 figure on the same StorageCafe page is about $102. The advertised rate on this page averages the published figures above. Once the move-in special ends and the first existing-customer increase lands, the six-month average sits above that street rate.
data_asof: Sep 2026 (StorageCafe street rates); no StorageUnitCosts city page; Oct 2026 (Storage Stats metro)

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. StorageCafe street rate $36 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$39.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. StorageCafe street rate $55 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$61. No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap).

Most rented size. City street rate $85, down 1.2% from a year earlier (StorageCafe industry statistics, Sep 2026). Storage Stats Indianapolis metro non-climate asking rent $102, down 3.5% from a year earlier (updated Oct 28, 2026). That figure covers the metro, not Indianapolis alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish this city. Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$102.
Two-bedroom contents. StorageCafe street rate $112 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$133.
Three-bedroom home or a car. StorageCafe street rate $139 (Sep 2026). Climate-controlled figure on the same page ~$172.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Hill Valley Estates (~$73), Woodsong (~$80), Park Valley Estates (~$82) among the cheaper areas for a standard unit. West Edgewood (~$501) is among the highest.
Indianapolis has about 126 facilities and 7.0 sq ft of storage per person (StorageCafe).
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts' fee notes, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
